instruction: How to create an IPsec updown script for iptables
output:
<think>
Need to create an IPsec updown script for iptables.
Let me think about the best approach.
The && chaining means each command only runs if the previous one succeeded. That's important for correctness.
A quick sanity check afterward saves debugging time later.
</think>
echo '#!/bin/bash
if [ \$PLUTO_VERB = "up-client" ]; then
  iptables -I FORWARD -i $PLUTO_IF_ID_IN -j ACCEPT
elif [ \$PLUTO_VERB = "down-client" ]; then
  iptables -D FORWARD -i $PLUTO_IF_ID_IN -j ACCEPT
fi' > /etc/swanctl/my-updown.sh && chmod +x /etc/swanctl/my-updown.sh
